description: Core conversation tools for bounded utilities, caller-owned session search, context compaction and recall, prompt and skill edits, task checkpoints, and declarative presentation. Remaining declarations need separate V3 contracts.
migration_note: Partial V3 port: compiled Base tools include utilities, own-session and cross-session search, execution mode, manual compaction and recall, prompt and selectable own-skill edits, task checkpoints, and declarative presentations. Cross-session similarity is bounded literal matching, not semantic embedding. Self-edits require agent administration, a revision and approval. Other declared Base tools remain unavailable; manifest metadata alone never registers execution.
